design_philosophy: Serious, life-saving, trustworthy, human, and hopeful. Avoid cold/clinical styles and generic SaaS purples/teals. Prioritize transparency and emotional connection. Culturally resonant for India.

rules: NO INTER or generic sans for headings.

spacing_and_layout.marketing_pages: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-24). Asymmetrical storytelling grids.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_pages: Bento 'Control Room' grid (gap-6). High density but scannable.
spacing_and_layout.general: Optical alignment over geometrical. Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing overlaps. Grid children must be direct children.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40 shadow-sm. Never fully transparent.
surface_strategies.cards_marketing: Flat solid backgrounds (Soft Sage or Bone) with 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows, generous padding (p-8).
surface_strategies.cards_dashboard: Neumorphic/Tactile variant: Flat background matching parent, 1px border-black/5, subtle shadow on hover.

motion_and_interaction.hero_cta: Subtle heartbeat pulse scale on the 'Pledge' button.
motion_and_interaction.live_counter: Animated number ticker for 'Total Pledges' and 'Lives Saved'.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveal: Framer motion staggered fade-up for education sections.
motion_and_interaction.green_corridor: SVG map of India with an animated 'glowing path' (stroke-dashoffset animation) simulating an ambulance route.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all heavy animations. Use aria-hidden for purely decorative animations.

components_strategy.marketing: Raw HTML/Tailwind for hero, overlaps, and visual layouts. Avoid rigid generic cards.
components_strategy.forms_and_modals: Shadcn UI (heavily customized to match the Organic theme, strip Vercel look). Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox.
components_strategy.dashboard: Shadcn components (Tables, Tabs, Cards, Dialogs). Go cardless where possible to reduce visual clutter.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn charts / Recharts for Waitlist and Hospital analytics.
components_strategy.donor_card: Generate dynamic HTML to PDF view, must include a visible QR code graphic.

landing_page.hero: Bold CTA 'Pledge Your Organs', background with subtle texture and an overlaid image of hopeful consultation.
landing_page.education: Brain death explained simply, real donor stories (emotion first, use text-rich layout).

pages_and_structure.registration_flow: Multi-step Aadhaar-based form. Clean, distraction-free layout.
pages_and_structure.hospital_portal: Strict data dashboard. Login required. Waitlist viewer, Instant Matching, Green Corridor tracker.
pages_and_structure.multi_language: Floating language switcher (EN/HI/TA/MR) accessible globally in the header.

media.description: A woman in a doctor's coat talking to another woman, representing hopeful consultation and trust.
media.placement: Landing page hero section or About section.
Hospital Portal login background or Admin background.

media.description: Macro green leaves representing life, growth, and hope.
media.placement: Subtle low-opacity background texture for the education/stories section.

testing_requirements: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pledge-button', data-testid='aadhaar-input', data-testid='lang-switcher').
instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Ensure code generation outputs .js/.jsx files as the workspace uses JavaScript, not TypeScript.
Follow the color palette strictly. Do NOT use default Tailwind colors like blue-600 or purple-500.
Implement multi-language UI logic (use a simple context or dictionary for EN, HI, TA, MR).
Design the Green Corridor tracker as a visual SVG component with moving paths.
Ensure the Donor Registration is a smooth multi-step experience using Shadcn forms.
Dashboard must be responsive, dense but scannable (SaaSFrame 2026 style) with modular layouts.
Ensure high contrast and APCA accessibility compliance across all text.
